_doc: Every contract copy this repo pins from a producer, and the producer branch it must equal. scripts/harness/pinned_contract_gate.py fails when a copy differs from the producer's develop. Refresh = copy the file, never edit it. The copies live beside this file, at the repo root, and NOT under internal/**/testdata: a producer's spec legitimately names fields this context must never hold (today node-topology's NodeRegistered carries the node's postal code), and internal/architecture/pii_fitness_test.go scans internal/, cmd/ and features/ for exactly those identifiers. See docs/docs/development/contract-testing.md.
